responses: Your scholarship may be temporarily suspended since the scholarship is granted for those who are currently enrolled and the the grantee need to maintain full-time student status to keep scholarship.

For Br. Arnold Reche FSC Program, yes, it is. For the other scholarship programs it may not be renewable. 
 For more info you can visit the Scholarship and Admission Officer 
 email: admission@lsu.edu.ph 
 contact number:(088) 521-1010

patterns: terms and conditions of the scholarship?
responses:
The applicant must meet the requirements for the scholarship.
 The applicant must be a Filipino Citizen. 
 For Academic, the scholarship is granted to Top students, and must maintain all his/her grade and have a GPA of 1.75. 
 For Non-Academic, scholarship is granted to those financially challenged applicants and must also maintain a final grade of all subject of atleast 80%. 
 If you ever change your major or you shift into another course it will depends on the Scholarship Committee decision.
 For more detailed information visit Scholarhip and admission office (SAO)
